correctness.rationale: For W=0^a1^b0^c1^d0^e with all positive exponents and scattered-subsequence order, the proof classifies all possible alternating skeletons of at most five runs using exact run-capacity rectangles and one-letter deletion minimality. Patterns with >=6 runs contain the absent 10101 proper subsequence and cannot be minimal. Seven unconditional and six conditional corner patterns exhaust the 13 templates. The exact count 7+x+y+z+xy+yz+xyz follows, and possible values are 7,8,9,10,13. Independently generated full subsequence downsets for 243 parameter 5-tuples in {1,2,3}^5 match every predicted basis and count; finite cases corroborate but are not the universal proof.
residual_risks: Finite 243-tuple enumeration is not a proof over arbitrary positive run lengths.
